user.title: Tempo Planner

data_description.tomorrow_color_entity: The colour of the next Tempo day (for example the RTE Tempo integration's next colour).
data_description.today_color_entity: The colour of the current Tempo day (e.g. the current colour from the RTE Tempo integration). The night is billed at its off-peak price; unknown counts as white.
data_description.solar_peak_entity: Time of tomorrow's highest solar power.
data_description.battery_soc_entity: State of charge of the home battery, in %.
data_description.car_soc_entity: State of charge of the car, in %.
data_description.car_plugged_entity: A binary sensor, or a plug status that reads "plugged" when connected.
data_description.car_target_entity: The car's own target, in %. Without it, the target in the settings is used.
data_description.house_energy_entity: An energy meter of what the house uses (kWh, with long-term statistics), not the grid import. Its history replaces the peak-hour consumption setting.
data_description.price_red_peak_entity: Prices in EUR/kWh. Without an entity, a default Tempo price is used (blue 0.1356 / 0.1654, white 0.1536 / 0.1921, red 0.1611 / 0.73).

user.description: Choose the entities the planner reads. Only tomorrow's colour is required.

settings.title: House

data.max_power_kw: Power available for the planned loads
data.battery_min_gain_ct: Minimum saving to charge the battery from the grid
data.dishwasher_solar_kwh: Solar forecast for a daytime dishwasher run

data_description.max_power_kw: What the subscription allows, minus what the house keeps for itself.
data_description.peak_load_kwh: Energy the house uses between the end and the start of the off-peak hours, before solar. Used when no house consumption entity is chosen or its history is still empty.
data_description.peak_load_days: How many past days are averaged to learn the peak-hour consumption: days of tomorrow's colour when at least 3 are known, otherwise the most recent days.
data_description.battery_min_gain_ct: Per kWh given back by the battery, after its losses. Set it to what a cycle costs in wear: battery price divided by its guaranteed cycles and capacity.
data_description.car_target_pct: Used when no target entity is set.
data_description.dishwasher_solar_kwh: On a blue day with at least this much solar forecast, the dishwasher runs around the solar peak.
data_description.car_min_kwh: Below this, no charge is planned.
